channel.title: DBX updates
channel.description: DBX release announcements: v1.3.0 vector migration, historical search, framework adapters, encrypted replication, and scoped support recovery.

item.title: DBX v1.3.0 — memory you can evolve and operate
item.description: Since v1.2.0: WAL-durable live vector migration, historical search over retained WAL, LangChain and LlamaIndex adapters, stronger Linux worker isolation, authenticated encrypted replication, and opt-in scoped support diagnostics with audited tenant wake. Includes dashboard and reliability improvements, Legal Auditor and Jurix examples, 43 support tests, and 1,340 synthetic drills. Upgrade steps and the full comparison are linked in the announcement.

item.title: Vector upgrades: migrate live, inspect history
item.description: VMIGRATE builds and promotes a shadow vector index while current search remains available. VSEARCH AS_OF replays retained vector WAL history for audit and RAG incident reproduction. Migration requires caller-side re-embedding and temporary storage; historical search is slower and bounded by WAL retention.

item.title: v1.2.0 — recall an agent can actually call
item.description: v1.2.0 keeps Isolation Kernel and finishes the recall surface: VSEARCH MIN_SCORE/EF/SPACE, VSIM, VFUSE, playground tabs, public site. Better as a product; same 2.304 ms ANN p50 and 14–17 MiB strict idle RSS. GitHub Release v1.2.0. GHCR :v1.2.0.

item.title: Tenant recall: VSEARCH, VSIM, VFUSE
item.description: Engine detail for the v1.2.0 cut. Per-tenant recall covers semantic VSEARCH (MIN_SCORE, EF, SPACE), similar-to-id VSIM, and late-fusion VFUSE. Embeddings stay with the caller. Certified ANN p50 is 2.304 ms.

item.title: v1.1.0 — Isolation Kernel
item.description: Linux strict: own process, Landlock, encrypted WAL/meta/graph. SQ8 .vec rows stay mmap plaintext. Not SOC 2.

item.title: v1.0.0 — single-node GO
